Project Respawn
PROJECT RESPAWN

ABOUT US

Your past is just the tutorial.
Your real game starts now.

Project Respawn is building a connected gaming, community and creator ecosystem designed to help people participate, pursue the things they care about and make connection feel easier.

For creators
Help build Project Respawn
THE MISSION
Gaming can be more than entertainment.

We believe shared interests can create lower-pressure reasons to take part, meet people and build momentum — online and beyond the screen.

Find your thing
→
Take part
→
Build momentum
◉About Project Respawn
⌁Our Vision
🎮Game Developers
🤝Partners
✦Brands & Rewards
◎Research & Impact

WHY PROJECT RESPAWN EXISTS

Being connected all the time has not made connection easy for everyone.

Project Respawn started from a simple problem: people can love games, creators and online communities while still finding it difficult to join conversations, meet new people, recover from awkward moments or take the first step into a group.

01
Starting can feel enormous

A first message, first voice chat or first event can carry far more pressure than it appears to from the outside.
